title: Figure 20. Predicted Suppression of Vacuum Fluctuations in dB (Casimir cavity BHD)
description: Line plot of predicted vacuum-fluctuation level in dB (y-axis, roughly -4 to 4) versus frequency ω/c in 1/μm (x-axis, 0 to about 13), showing sawtooth-shaped curves that dip below zero. Caption: "Figure 20. Predicted Suppression of Vacuum Fluctuations in dB. (courtesy of P. Marecki)"; a solid line is for a BHD at x = 0.25 μm and a dashed line for x = 0.5 μm within the cavity. Surrounding text discusses sub-vacuum fluctuations, the Quantum Inequalities theorem and a proposed Casimir cavity balanced homodyne detection experiment.
